purpose: Verificar contrato dimensional do modelo finito R9 por álgebra e cálculo sintético, sem dado observado, sem calibração universal.
status: INPUT choices; DERIVED identities to be checked computationally

secondary_ground_instance.status: INPUT synthetic; not an atomic-clock energy prescription

assertions.claim: Conjugation, positive spectrum, root dissipator and rate agree on all four M2 basis matrices.
Root and quadratic generators agree for the same two-level gap with tau_eff; root and matched echo agree at n*echo_dt.
Scaling V0,Eref,kappa by lambda scales Omega,gamma by lambda and tau_eff,echo_dt,P by 1/lambda; channel at t/lambda and Gibbs weights invariant.
Finite Gibbs modular flow and physical Heisenberg flow obey sigma_s=alpha_(-P*s).
The old echo w1=1.30,dt=0.35 is incompatible with positive-offset root rates on its active two-level sector in the same clock.
A single tau cannot equate root and quadratic rates on energy levels 0,E,4E.
Energy shifts leave Gibbs/unitary flows unchanged but change root rates.
assertions.falsifier: Eref=V0 and Eref=2V0 have equal gamma.

assertions.claim: The Supercondutor holographic jump is nonunital, so its dissipator is not unitarily equivalent to the Hermitian root dephasing dissipator.
assertions.falsifier: J Jdagger - Jdagger J =0 in its declared finite model.

assertions.claim: Old echo on full dimension16 distinguishes degenerate zero-energy states, so it cannot equal f(H) dephasing there.
assertions.falsifier: The 0,2 matrix unit is preserved by the old mirror map.

assertions.claim: NaN, infinities, bool, zero/negative positive-required fields, Eref<V0, and numeric overflow are visibly refused.
assertions.falsifier: Any invalid input returns an accepted contract.

limitations: No experimental significance or five sigma result
No global light-net or full H2 inhabitant
